sources.contract: Actual official trace helper used by fixture; its successful callback sets parent step status OK then ends it.

sources.label: officialSpanStatus
sources.contract: An OK status overrides prior ERROR and later status changes are ignored. Relevant to refused-result proposal.

semantics: Workflow trace success sets its own span OK after the callback returns; original asToolResult returned an error object before that point.
OTel Span.setStatus permits OK to replace prior ERROR, so marking the SDK-owned span would not survive.
withRunSpan owns a distinct child, catches real thrown errors with safeErrorAttributes, and never changes status on successful callback completion.
Repository returned Resolution errors are explicitly marked inside resolveRepository, then a closed code is applied to the enclosing owned dispatch span before it ends.
Existing sanitizers discard messages, stacks, arbitrary error content and unapproved attribute keys. No arbitrary returned object is scanned.
